name: @call-booking/contract
description: TypeSpec sources of the API contract. `make generate` emits the OpenAPI spec and the TS types consumed by server/ and web/. Generated artifacts are committed and never hand-edited.

scripts.generate: tsp compile . && openapi-typescript openapi.yaml -o ../server/src/generated/schema.d.ts && openapi-typescript openapi.yaml -o ../web/src/generated/schema.d.ts && node scripts/post-generate.mjs
